description: Retro planning guardrails. The retro of the Effect-TS step-0 run found four process defects:

userStories.title: The plan finds callers of a changed signature and adds a changelog criterion
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `/prd` to own each caller of a changed signature so that no worker blocks on a test fake.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § 3 holds a caller rule for a story that changes the signature of an exported function. The advisor runs `git grep -n <symbol>` across source and test files. The advisor adds each caller and each test fake to the `files` of that story.
`.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § 5 holds a changelog rule for a user-facing change. When `CHANGELOG.md` has an `## [Unreleased]` section, one story owns `CHANGELOG.md` and has a changelog criterion.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed: diff adds caller rule at prd SKILL.md:90 next to generated-output rule and changelog rule at :176 in Stories; executed: ste-check same 6 pre-existing findings before and after, none on changed lines; executed: link-providers.sh --check exit 0.

userStories.title: Delegate records a test baseline before the first wave
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want a recorded test baseline so that each worker can tell a pre-existing failure from a new failure.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Waves holds a baseline step before the first dispatch. The advisor runs the test and type-check commands on the task branch. The advisor records each failing test in `.agro/tasks/<slug>/evidence/baseline.md`.
`.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Worker brief gives each worker the baseline failures. A baseline failure does not fail a criterion of the worker.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.

userStories.title: Council pins the source revision
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want each council member to read one pinned revision so that no member reads a checkout that another agent owns.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` § 2 holds a revision rule. The shared brief names the source revision of each repository as a full commit SHA of its default branch.
The rule tells each member to read files at that revision with `git show <sha>:<path>`, and never through a checkout that another agent owns.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed: council SKILL.md § 2 new step 5 names the source revision as a full default-branch SHA, read with git show <sha>:<path>, never a checkout another agent owns; executed: ste-check same single pre-existing finding before/after, none on changed lines; executed: link-providers.sh --check exit 0; reasoned: no in-skill references to § 2 step numbers.

userStories.title: Changelog and manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a changelog entry and a command transcript so that I can confirm the skill changes without a rerun.
acceptanceCriteria: `CHANGELOG.md` holds one entry under `## [Unreleased]` that names the three rules and links the task issue.
`.agro/tasks/retro-planning-guardrails/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the commands and exit codes of `bash .agro/scripts/link-providers.sh --check`, `pnpm test`, and the three `ste-check.sh` runs.
